description: VERY EARLY TESTING -- this is the first release and it has never been run at a real event. Fewer than a third of its features have been tested in a live game at all. Expect bugs, expect to lose a build, and please do not run it on anything you would be upset to lose. Creative custom game built for hosting building events: claimable plots with teams, an event clock, anti-grief protection you can arm in one command, whole-world snapshots you can roll back to, and a ban list that survives between events. Block mods can be enabled alongside it: ONLY ADD MODS YOU TRUST. There is no sandbox between mods, so anything you tick runs on your machine with the same reach this one has.
name: Server Works
